notes.title: New Mining Mechs DLC releases this month!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Hope you're all doing great! As you might know, I'm currently working on two DLCs, one for Mining Mechs and one for the sequel Super Mining Mechs. Both DLCs are set to launch at the end of this month on Friday February 28th.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2830150/view/523081237389116264]In a recent post[/url] I talked about the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/]Toxic Treasures DLC[/url] for Super Mining Mechs, so this week I'd like to take some time to talk about the contents of the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/]Camel Chaos DLC[/url] for the original Mining Mechs!

But first, please take some time to wishlist both DLC here to be notified when they launch! It also helps a lot for the Steam algorithm :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/

[h3]About Camel Chaos[/h3]
This brand new adventure takes you to the desert, as weird animal noises have been detected underground... and that can only mean one thing; you're needed for another mining adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/f73843dd40699ee2d3a6d2e0233cd0293966efca.png[/img]
As you dig down you'll encounter lots of wild camels. Although friendly, these are a jumpy bunch, and so you need to catch them to calm them down. You can then ride them around to unlock gates and doorways. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/2832f5bb79bf5e8708c1504fb1fd617775886178.png[/img]
The new DLC also features 5 brand new mechs, 13 new resources to mine and a lot of underground pyramids connect your piping system to. And can you find the secret extra pyramid?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/8eb240414c85d7051aa6de7a602dd7ee883ebb69.png[/img]
[h3]Pricing:[/h3]
Mining Mechs - Camel Chaos: [b]$0.99[/b]
Super Mining Mechs - Toxic Treasures: [b]$1.99[/b]
Both DLCs will have a launch discount, and there will also be a bundle to get an additional discount when you get both DLCs at once!

PS: I've received a lot of requests to release the OST of Super Mining Mechs ever since the game launched, so I'm also releasing the OST alongside these DLCs! If you're into OSTs you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487300/Super_Mining_Mechs_Soundtrack/]find it here[/url].

[h3]Please Wishlist![/h3]
Lastly - please don't forget to wishlist both DLC. It helps out a lot for the Steam algorithm and makes sure you get notified when they launch. This way you won't miss the launch discount!

And as always - thank you all for your continued support! I'd love to hear your thoughts on the upcoming DLC and if you have any questions please feel free to ask them below! :)
-Barry

notes.title: DLC Release Date & Content Reveal!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Hope you're having a great first month of the year! I've been making great progress with the upcoming DLCs for both Mining Mechs and Super Mining Mechs, and so today I'd like to share that both DLCs are set to launch on Friday February 28th. 

In this post I'm zooming in on Super Mining Mechs - Toxic Treasures. But first, please take some time to wishlist both DLC here to be notified when they launch! It also helps a lot for the Steam algorithm :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/

[h3]About Toxic Treasures[/h3]
The DLC adds a brand new planet to Super Mining Mechs called "Toxera", which is a dangerous and toxic place full of acid. You receive a distress call from Doctor Dica, a German scientist who's underground laboratory is flooded with acid. He asks you to dive down in a special submarine mech to restore his labs, but can you really trust him?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/fe008866de5e7f0bd84329b99ba7fe2b728d2116.png[/img]

Naturally, you can upgrade and customize your submarine mech to increase your underwater (or should I say under-acid) mining speed. However - that doesn't mean your old trusty super mining mech is not useful on Toxera either, as you can drain the acid by restoring pumps, draining the acid from certain regions and allowing for your regular mech to mine there. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/db4e3cc24aa2b6524a8d297f232035b9bbd67466.png[/img]

Toxera contains 20 brand new resources to find in the Lanthanide and Actinide element groups. And of course - once cleared of acid - you can build mines on this planet to mine them passively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/97373dc09f944d64e60d6a56aa02a1b5ab2e8805.png[/img]

While underwater, you can move around freely in any direction - which also means you can mine in any direction - even upwards! That's right, I know many of you have requested for mechs to be able to mine upwards, so here you go! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/d040c299142e0d19d921c0b1f5cb80f72fefbce2.png[/img]

[h3]Pricing:[/h3]
Mining Mechs - Camel Chaos: [b]$0.99[/b]
Super Mining Mechs - Toxic Treasures: [b]$1.99[/b]
Both DLCs will have a launch discount, and there will also be a bundle to get an additional discount when you get both DLCs at once!

[h3]Testing[/h3]
Want to help me test the upcoming DLCs? Awesome! We're still actively looking for enthusiastic testers. For more information check out the #announcements channel in our Discord.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/RKpJp8Huvx style=button]Discord[/url]

[h3]Please Wishlist![/h3]
Lastly - please don't forget to wishlist both DLC. It helps out a lot for the Steam algorithm and makes sure you get notified when they launch. This way you won't miss the launch discount!

And as always - thank you all for your continued support! I'd love to hear your thoughts on the upcoming DLC and if you have any questions please feel free to ask them below! :)
-Barry

notes.title: Super Mining Mechs Devlog #5: Base Building
notes.content:
This is a devlog of my new game Super Mining Mechs. If you want to read more devlogs (the next one is already published!) make sure to follow and wishlist Super Mining Mechs on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/

--

Hey everyone!

In this week's Devlog I'd like to share an exciting new feature in Super Mining Mechs; Base Building! 

(PS: if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so! this way you'll be notified when the game launches)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

[h3]Building Basics[/h3]
Let's start with the basics; what do buildings do and how does it work? Building underground allows you to build bases that you can use for all sorts of stuff. To start building, simply select what you want to build from your building selector (which is similar to the item selector) and place it on the ground. Once placed, you need to construct it by delivering the right materials. Each building requires a certain amount of resources from specified categories of the period table of elements (indicated by the color). You can choose what resources from within the required categories you want to deliver. Once delivered, you can complete the construction!

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Power[/h3]
The first building you need is a power plant, which is used to power all the other buildings. It draws its power from an energy crystal, which can be found throughout the map by their glowing roots. Once dig up, you can place a power plant on top and deliver the right materials to construct it. From there, you can run a cable to your buildings using connectors.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/230830fedab490edc5ebbc9aac9f0d161e1be9ad.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/af2139a71c198ef9b3cede87747cfa38c0b8509a.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Mines[/h3]
Mines are the most important buildings in Super Mining Mechs, as they can mine resources autonomously and they are the map objectives. Similar to how power plants can only be built on top of energy crystals, mines can only be built on mining sites, located in caves. Once constructed, the mine can be powered by running a power line from the power plant to the mine, and there you go; passive mining![/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Platforms[/h3]
Platforms were probably one of the most requested features in Mining Mechs, as you cannot dig while flying, which sometimes makes it hard to reach valuable resources. Luckily the building mechanic offers a good solution for this. You can now build platforms on any location from which you can dig left or right![/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/81b3e6ad06cca155d18b3cbbb64e4eb0df3d99b5.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/6223ecb4bf8b2619f2753e85f59266726932f8d0.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Radar[/h3]
Another much requested feature was a mini map, so I'm happy to say I've added a radar that enables the mini map for its surrounding environment. As you can see in the start of the video, the mini map is not receiving any signal. Then, when the radar tower is constructed and powered, you can see the mini map turning on.[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Portal[/h3]
Although the teleporter item can be used to quickly move above ground from any point underground, it's not possible to get back down. The advantage of a portal is that it can be used in two directions, so you can get back up to your pod quickly, drop stuff off, and get back down quickly.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/04b83a07e98d3d9ac081979e6f618b9d77ad7939.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

There's a couple more buildings but we'll cover those in a later devlog as they are related to another new feature I want to cover seperately! Hope you guys are enjoying these devlogs - if so, please feel free to drop a comment below. Want to vote on the next devlog topic, or suggest a feature? Join the Discord or leave a comment below!
[url=https://discord.gg/JJEXTyw4/ style=button]Join Discord[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2830150/view/4622469476333303384 style=button]Next Devlog →[/url]

notes.title: Super Mining Mechs Devlog #3: Digging & Gathering
notes.content:
This is a devlog of my new game Super Mining Mechs. If you want to read more devlogs (the next one is already published!) make sure to follow and wishlist Super Mining Mechs on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/

--

Hey everyone!

This Devlog is about a small but very important update to the game changing the way resources are gathered. One of the things I personally love most about Mining Mechs is that it's relaxing and satisfying. I'm always trying to tweak and optimize this to see how I can make the game the game even more satisfying and I think this update is a really good example of that, so I figured I'd share this with you all this week.

(PS: if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so! this way you'll be notified when the game launches)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

Little disclaimer before I start; please keep in mind that this part of the game is still in active development. There are placeholders / missing things in all of the GIFs and everything is subject to change.

[h3]Early game[/h3]
When you're just starting out your mining speed will be low. This is not much different from the previous Mining Mechs game, with the exception of the digging being continuous and the gathered resources popping up over your head.
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/4135f608f3741f36d44ef6c3ee223281a6a9093d.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/6ce34b870ceda0d2d235a88ef4e13d2931f3a7a0.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Late game[/h3]
Now this is what it would look like with a late game build. As you can see here you can cut through dirt like butter and you gather multiple resources with each ore you mine. In a matter of seconds you can now gather what previously took minutes. You can also see the color and animation of the text change based on the combo you get.
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/82392e363cc136638583150f88e1867fae94efab.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/480de8a0fc14230c0a6185689a6b3c109191387e.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Of course getting to the end game parts will take a long time and the progress will be gradual. I would love to know what you all think of this update. I'm considering adding a combo bonus to the gathered resources too so that for example there'd be a multiplier bonus when you hit a combo chain of 100.

Alright, that's all I have to share for now. Want to vote on the next devlog topic, or suggest a feature? Join the Discord or leave a comment below!
[url=https://discord.gg/JJEXTyw4/ style=button]Join Discord[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2830150/view/6715516228621786578 style=button]Next Devlog →[/url]

notes.title: New Game+ is now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's finally there! Many of you requested a New Game+ mode, and it's now finally here. The latest patch adds New Game+ to Mining Mechs and in this post I'll talk more about what that includes.

[h2]What is New Game+?[/h2]
So what is it? New Game+ is available after you finish the game. By finishing the storyline you are awarded 1 token, which will grant you a bonus for your next run. Tokens stay with you forever. Any new game you start - whether through New Game+ or by actually starting a new save file, you'll still keep your tokens. You'll even keep them when joining someone elses multiplayer game! 

[h2]How to start a New Game+[/h2]
Before I get into more details about the bonus stats of the tokens, let's first explain how to start a New Game+. When completing the base game an airship will now come down and float right above the quest giver. Get on board to interact with it and open the New Game+ menu. This menu will explain what starting a New Game+ means: you will lose all player progression and it will reset your map, but you will be able to play a new round with the token bonus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/ad825ab04a8ff0f2e5ff62a0234f21d4b3f16a05.png[/img]

[h2]Tokens[/h2]
But what does a token do? Each token adds the following bonus for your next run:
[list]
[*] +$1000 starting cash
[*] +1 mech upgrade point
[*] +25% pump revenue
[*] +10 starting confetti[/list]
I guess the starting cash bonus speaks for itsself; you get an extra $1000 bonus cash for each token you own. Remember though - tokens stack - so 10 tokens means 10k extra starting cash!

Each token also awards you with an extra mech upgrade point. This upgrade point can be added to every mech you own, meaning 1 single token can add an upgrade point to all mechs you own at the same time. You can spend and deduct upgrade points like any other upgrade point. The token bonus also doesn't affect your level, meaning 10 tokens will grant you +10 upgrade points, but your mech will still be level 1 and upgrading it will still be cheap!

Next, the pump revenue is boosted by 25% for each token and just as with the other bonuses this one stacks as well. Connecting mines is now more rewarding than ever!

Lastly and most importantly; +10 starting confetti for each token. Obviously the use of confetti to celebrate wins in life is a crucial aspect of mining. Soon you'll never have to buy confetti again and you'll have enough confetti to celebrate even the smallest wins! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/c8db131d1d64261a2d5e1879a506eb4f28d1d305.png[/img]

[h2]New Map[/h2]
Many players have been asking me for more content and to extend the map. While New Game+ adds replayability to the base game, I also totally understand you might not want to grind the same map multiple times. Luckily, from tomorrow the airship will not only be able to get you started with a New Game+, but it will also transport you to new DLC maps! The first map is set in the arctics. It's the same size as the original map and features a brand new storyline, new mechs, new resources and of course it will grant tokens upon completion as well! 

You can wishlist the DLC here and make sure to get your tokens up today to get a running start when the DLC hits!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695280/

Thanks everyone, talk to you soon!

notes.title: DLC Release Date + Beta Test Round 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Last weekend a lot of people helped out with the beta test of the upcoming DLC called Mining Mechs - Magnetic Mystery. Huge thank you to everyone who helped out! The test went well and so I've decided to set the release date for as soon as 19 December. In this post I'm sharing a little more about what's included in the DLC. If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695280/Mining_Mechs__Magnetic_Mystery/

This weekend we'll have another beta test so if you're interested in trying out an early version of the DLC - head over the our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/RKpJp8Huvx


[h3]The Story[/h3]
Mining Mechs - Magnetic Mystery takes place in a brand new map located in the arctics. Strange magnetic field disturbances are being picked up deep down into the earth and it's up to you to find out what is going on. I won't spoil any more of the story - but rest assured it's going to be an interesting adventure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/c0de1a410990c85647862cada2dbdf1858216cf7.png[/img]

[h3]The Map[/h3]
I wanted the new map to feel fresh and unique while not straying away too far from the original gameplay, so some things will feel familiar while the map also introduces some new things. For starters, just like the old map this one features 10 basic resources and 3 types of gems. However, unique to the new map is that ores are now often found in clusters. Finding many resources at a time doesn't mean the DLC is easier than the base game though. Compared to the base game the resources are worth slightly less with the idea that finding more resources with less value should result in a nice balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/1c2a2e8ae674aac19ccbdeb38f42e374714ed1ed.png[/img]

[h3]The Mechs[/h3]
The DLC also features 5 new mechs. With the new map containing more resources these mechs have a relatively large inventory allowing you to carry more resources than you're used to. Also, having less mechs in this map compared to the base game means you'll have to use it longer and skipping one will be much harder!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/df532a14d0347a9f12c465cabd637327d52c284e.png[/img]

[h3]New Game+[/h3]
Of course all of this ties in nicely with the upcoming New Game+ mode which will be released as a free update to the base game. This new feature will grant you a Token each time you complete the base game, but also when you complete the DLC story. Tokens will provide you a little bonus on each new playthrough like additional starting cash, extra mine / pump revenue and an additional mech upgrade point to spend. Depending on how the next playtest goes, I'm planning to release the New Game+ mode either right before or together with the DLC on December 19th.

notes.title: New Game+ and DLC Open Beta (looking for testers!)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this post I wanted to give some updates on recent progress with the development of the upcoming New Game + update as well as the new DLC. I'm also looking for players who want to help me test the DLC as early as tomorrow! More information about testing at the very end of this post.

[h2]Recent updates[/h2]
First of all a quick update on progress since launch. I have worked very hard to polish the game as much as I can and fix any bugs / crashes that were reported. It's starting to look like that paid off as the recent review score has turned "Overwhelmingly Positive" which is an amazing milestone I honestly never in my life would have thought that this small tiny game would reach! It's an amazing feeling to see people enjoying my game every day so I'm very thankful for all your support and I'm very dedicated to improve and expand the game! Thank you!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/32363341fe144ee6d97654f4e83dd50caca79a70.png[/img]

[h2]New Game +[/h2]
I've managed to make good progress on the development of the New Game + mode, which allows you to replay the game while keeping a so called 'token'. In the New Game + update, after finishing the game, you will now see the airship come down and drop you a rope. If you get up there, you'll be able to start a New Game +. This will generate a new map and reset all your player progress except for 1 thing; your tokens. These tokens that you get for finishing the game will then grant you the following in the next play session:
[list]
[*] Boosting passive income by 25%
[*] Adding 1 additional upgrade point to spend on your mechs
[/list]
Of course these tokens stack - so if you finish the game 4 times, you'll be granted +100% passive income as well as 4 additional upgrade points to spend on each mech!

Another fun thing about tokens is that they are account based - so not save based. What this means is that your tokens will be with you even when joining other peoples online games, and any tokens earned in online games even if you're not hosting will stay with you forever!

[h2]DLC Progress[/h2]
As you might already know from previous community hub posts I'm currently working on a DLC that'll add a brand new map into the game, alongside new resources to gather and new mechs to unlock and play with. Today I want to share a first screenshot of the new DLC map. More updates coming soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/c0de1a410990c85647862cada2dbdf1858216cf7.png[/img]

You can wishlist the DLC now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695280/

[h3]Looking for testers![/h3]
To make sure the DLC is polished and well tested before release, I'm looking for people who want to help me test it. How does this work? Well, it's very simple - you join the [url=https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx]Discord[/url] and ask to become a tester. You'll then be granted access to the testing channel where you'll get access to the DLC this weekend! The only thing I ask for is that you play through it and share any feedback, bugs or crashes that you may find.
As a thank you, anyone who helps test the game will be granted the DLC for free!

Altright, that's all for today. Thanks again to the community for all your support so far and I hope you're as excited for the DLC as I am!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been nearly a month since Mining Mechs released (time flies!) so I figured it's time to give you all a little update on what has happened since launch and most importantly; what's next!

[h2]Progress so far[/h2]
In the weeks after launch I've mainly focused on fixing bugs and polishing the game. I'm glad to say there wasn't an overwhelming amount of bugs on launch but there's definitely been a fair amount of bugs and crashes that I've fixed - thank you for your bug reports and of course for your patience and understanding. Also thanks to your feedback and suggestions I've managed to add a couple of important quality of life updates and balancing changes such as increased pump revenue, reduced mech upgrade costs and increased item capacity. I've also introduced the community's most requested feature; the Mechipedia menu - which provides an overview of all resources you've found, where you can find them, how much they are worth and how many you've mined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44613638/ab37e325515e90270257341c1ddd43f97c9c38df.png[/img]

For more patch notes from recent updates, please visit our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx]https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx[/url]

[h2]What's next[/h2]
Now the big question is of course; what's next? The feedback I got most from the community is that players would love to play more when reaching the end of the game, but they simply ran out of map to dig. For this reason I've decided that my main focus will be to extend the gameplay time of the game and I'll be doing this in 2 ways.

[h3]1. New Game +[/h3]
Many players have requested a "New Game +" or "Prestige" system where they can transfer some progress over to a new map and keep playing. I'm glad to announce that I will be adding a "New Game +" option to the game. This will work as follows:

Once you've completed the game, you'll be able to visit the airship where you can choose to start a new game. By doing this you will lose all progress, including your mechs, money, pump upgrades, pipe system and items. The map will regenerate and you'll basically start from scratch. However - by doing this you will gain a token. This token will increase the pump revenue and also adds an additional upgrade point to spend on each mech. You can stack as many tokens as you want to make each playthrough even faster than the previous one!

[h3]2. New Content[/h3]
This is probably the most requested thing by the community; new content. I'm glad to announce that I'm working on the first DLC featuring:
[list][*]A new map
[*]A new story line
[*]5 New Mechs
[*]New resources[/list]
As I mentioned my focus is on adding content to the game - not on implementing new features. This means the DLC will not feature any significant gameplay changes, but rather offers additional content to play.

I've thought long and hard about selling a DLC and I'm still not entirely sure about it, but right now I plan to sell the DLC for $0.99USD (regional pricing will apply). The reason I'm planning a paid DLC is because the base game is only $2.99 and I had not planned to actively expand the game with new content. Selling the DLC rather than offering it as free content will allow me to spend more time and resources on the content and even more importantly - I'd be able to support the game for a much longer time with even more content in the future.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
As always I value your feedback very much. At the end of the day I'm not making the game for myself - I'm making it for you all to play, so if you have any feedback or thoughts please let me know in the comments here, on the community hub or on [url=https://discord.gg/RKpJp8Huvx]Discord[/url]!

Thank you all for the support so far and I'm excited for what's to come!
